# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

This project ([PROJECT_NAME]) is an IIT Mandi ISP course project, and we
want anyone interacting with it — filing an issue, opening a pull
request, or discussing the work — to have a straightforward, respectful
experience regardless of their background or experience level.

We pledge to make participation in this project a harassment-free
experience for everyone.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and considerate in comments, issues, and pull requests.
- Give and accept constructive feedback gracefully.
- Focus criticism on the work, not the person.
- Respect that this is a small academic project maintained largely by
  one person, with correspondingly limited response time.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks of any kind.
- Publishing others' private information without consent.
- Submitting malicious content (see `SECURITY.md` for what is
  specifically out of scope for this project — real credentials, real
  phishing content, attacks against third parties, etc.).
- Any other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate
  in a professional or academic setting.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces (issues, pull
requests, discussions) and in any other context where an individual is
representing the project or its community.

## Enforcement Responsibilities

The project maintainer (Naman Khatak) is responsible for clarifying
and enforcing standards of acceptable behavior and will take
appropriate, fair corrective action in response to any behavior deemed
inappropriate, threatening, or harmful.

## Reporting

Instances of unacceptable behavior may be reported to:

**Naman Khatak** — namankhatak@gmail.com

All reports will be reviewed and handled with discretion.

## Enforcement Guidelines

Given the scale of this project, enforcement will generally follow:

1. **Correction** — a private, respectful note about the issue.
2. **Warning** — a warning if behavior continues after a first
   correction.
3. **Removal** — removal of comments, issues, or pull requests, and
   blocking further contributions, for repeated or severe violations.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor
Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1, trimmed
for the scale of a small academic project.
